notes.title: Mars 2055 - Hello darkness my old friend
notes.content:
This update add the following:

[list]
[*] Ladder footsteps audio. • New fog. • Re-spawn points. 
[*] Oxygen depletion. • O2 bubble zones. • Second replacement suit. 
[*] New Space Station. • O2 refill in orbit. • Look damping. 
[*] New floating creature. • New interact retical. • HUD scaling. 
[*] More on boarding hints. • Interaction hints • Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update to v3.0.0
notes.content: This is a major update from v2.x.x to v3.x.x with all kinds of changes from new on boarding to better lighting. The best thing I can suggest is that you try it out and send us feedback using the integrated feedback feature. We will continue to listen and improve the game.

notes.title: Update with new puzzles and UI
notes.content: Fix a problem that made it difficult to pick up the energy cell. For now, don't require active HAL for inventory. Indicate the fence first is the wrong direction. Fix the Alien ship floor. Move dish control to the top of the ridge and fence the area. Add more clues to the location of reactor maintenance. Fix NonStop Q branding. Add no signal hint in Comms. Add in game settings for volume and quit. Widen ladders to make them easier to climb.

notes.title: Major update with many changes and improvements
notes.content:
Add and change the following:
[list]
[*] add heads up display
[*] add AI
[*] add inventory
[*] simplify one aspect of the communications puzzle
[*] change how key cards are used
[*] new UI theme
[*] add multi hit damage system
[*] add ambient noise zones
[*] more enemies
[*] more lava
[*] new shader for animated sky with sun and sky with stars
[*] create ladder mechanic and replace some stairs with ladders
[*] make the reactor puzzle more challenging
[*] make the O2 puzzle more challenging
[*] several performance improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Winter 2022 Update
notes.content: Add volumetric lighting. Add lava pools. Add lava falls. Add Martian plants.

notes.title: Halloween 2022 Update
notes.content: Added some spooky / scary content just in time for Halloween
